task_description:
# Complete Trakt Integration

Finish the Trakt watchlist status checks and ensure bidirectional sync for watch progress, ratings, and collections. Fix the TODO items in AppleTVHero.tsx and ensure Trakt status indicators appear throughout the UI.

## Rationale
Trakt integration is a key differentiator against Stremio (which lacks native Trakt) and Kodi (which has no cloud sync). Power users specifically choose apps based on Trakt support for cross-device progress tracking. This addresses the known gap in the codebase and competitor pain points pain-1-4 and pain-5-5.

## User Stories
- As a power user, I want my watch progress to sync to Trakt automatically so that I can continue watching on any device
- As a Trakt user, I want to see my watchlist status on content cards so that I know what I've already added
- As a media enthusiast, I want to rate content directly in Nuvio so that my Trakt profile stays updated

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Trakt watchlist status indicators show on all content cards and detail pages
- [ ] Watch progress syncs to Trakt within 30 seconds of playback events
- [ ] Users can add/remove items from Trakt watchlist directly from the app
- [ ] Trakt ratings can be set from the media detail screen
- [ ] Collection sync works bidirectionally with user's Trakt account
- [ ] TODO comments in AppleTVHero.tsx are resolved
